messages:
maya: Quick flag - billing shows some requests with project=null after latest auth patch. Suspect service account exchange flow.
leo: saw similar in staging. Any idea what changed?
tess: attribution order is header -> claim -> org-default. That allowed proxies to set X-Project-ID.
maya: exchange refresh path strips headers; if the token lacks the project claim we fall back to org default.
samir: propose route-level precedence toggle so internal exchange routes use claim -> header -> default.
leo: make it a config per route and emit telemetry `auth_attribution_source` and `token_category`. Start with 1% prod sample.
nora: UX: show `auth_attribution_source` in request inspector with a tooltip.
maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/504 includes precedence toggle, telemetry fields, and a debug log when fallback happens (redacted).
deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-precedence-toggle -> staging at 2025-06-18T11:12:00Z
tess: rollout: staging -> prod 1% sample -> monitor `project_attribution_unassigned_pct` and `project_mismatch_count` -> ramp.
samir: add alert if unassigned_pct > 0.5% for 10m.
leo: also log `project_mismatch=true` when header and claim disagree.
maya: will watch staging metrics and report back. Thanks.
